tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, inside the uncertified gray zone but below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The targeted high-gradient probe costs 3.0 and can distinguish continued smooth saturation from an added supercritical loss.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A good fit below the proposed onset would not establish that the smooth law holds above it.
All pilot gradients are below the proposed onset range, so the threshold and avalanche strength are unidentifiable.
It costs more and is not targeted at crossing the sink-gradient threshold.
